items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: When Norma came, she didn't stay away from you then, huh? Two years. But one morning about 2:00 o'clock she called me, after she got over her mad

ctx.x: Or fathers that long, but you just go with what you got while you got it. That's why I got that sign: 'God, grant me to accept change' (inaudible) the things I cannot tell you -- nothing I could do about that.
When Norma came, she didn't stay away from you then, huh?
Two years. But one morning about 2:00 o'clock she called me, after she got over her mad -- I don't know what the hell she was mad about.
